subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR introduce a separate compaction-time pruning and multi-pass compaction owner, or should it be narrowed to the existing context-pruning and compaction owners before merge?
rationale: The branch is implementing a product-level compaction architecture change with overlapping pruning behavior, and automation cannot choose the long-term owner boundary or prove the contributor's real setup.

options.title: Narrow to existing owners
options.body: Require the PR to reuse or extend existing context-pruning settings and compaction callers, then add real OpenClaw compaction proof before merge.

options.title: Accept a separate compaction-time owner
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly approve a distinct pruning/multi-pass owner, but the PR then needs documented precedence, upgrade proof, and real behavior evidence.

options.title: Defer to the canonical compaction architecture issue
options.body: Pause or close this branch if the design should be settled under issue #58398 before accepting implementation churn.

recommendation.title: Narrow to existing owners
recommendation.body: Require the PR to reuse or extend existing context-pruning settings and compaction callers, then add real OpenClaw compaction proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: @sallyom is assigned on the live PR and is the best visible routing owner for the product-direction choice.
